bio: Dorothy Patterson, Th.M, D.Min., is the author of several books, including A Woman Seeking God (Broadman, 1992). She was the assistant editor and a contributor for The Believers's Study Bible (Thomas Nelson, 1991). Dr. Patterson is affiliated with the Council on Biblical Manhood and Womanhood and is on the advisory board for Concerned Women for America. She and her husband, who is president of Southwestern Baptist Theological Seminary, live in Ft. Worth, Texas.
